analyzed_vuln.description: `ValidateArray(const Array&)` calls `array.null_count()` before validating that the array buffers are consistent with the declared length/offset and bitmap size. For fuzzed IPC data, `ArrayData::GetNullCount()` computes null count via `CountSetBits(buffers[0]->data(), offset, length)`, which trusts `length`/`offset` and reads bitmap words past the actual allocated validity buffer, causing the ASan heap-buffer-overflow in `CountSetBits`. Root cause is missing/incorrect pre-validation ordering in `ValidateArray` (unsafe use of derived null_count on untrusted ArrayData).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires constructing an Array from IPC input where a validity bitmap buffer exists but is smaller than what `offset + length` implies (or otherwise inconsistent with metadata), while null_count is unknown so `null_count()` recomputes via bitmap scan. In the `arrow-ipc-stream-fuzz` path (`FuzzIpcStream` -> `RecordBatch::ValidateFull` -> `ValidateArray`), malformed stream metadata propagates into `ArrayData`; `ValidateArray` calls `null_count()` early, leading `CountSetBits` to over-read the bitmap and crash.
